previous_statement: Compressed-unit obligation and conclusion. For every n put u_{P,n}=Co_{P_n}(P_n), the unit at the n-th amplified corner (at n=1 this is u_P, and under the amplified-corner convention these are the matrix-level units induced by u_P). It is self-adjoint by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities and P_n^dagger=P_n from def-delta-projection. Lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action gives ||u_{P,n} dot A-A||<=C_u*e||A|| and ||A dot u_{P,n}-A||<=C_u*e||A||. Since ||P_n||=||P||, nonvanishing of P passes to every P_n; hence lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm gives abs(||u_{P,n}||-1)<=C_N*e at every level. Together with nodes 1.2-1.4 and the constant choices in node 1.1, all epsilon-C*-axioms hold on every matrix level with error at most C_ca*e. Therefore def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra yields that S_P is an extended C_ca*e-C*-algebra with compressed product, inherited involution, and compressed unit u_P.
new_statement: Compressed-unit obligation. Let C_u,e_u and C_N,e_N be witnesses from lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action and lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm. For every n put P_n=I_n tensor P and u_{P,n}=Co_{P_n}(P_n), the unit of the n-th amplified corner; at n=1 this is u_P, and the amplified-corner convention makes these the matrix-level units induced by u_P. The element u_{P,n} is self-adjoint because P_n^dagger=P_n by def-delta-projection and lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities gives Co_{P_n}(P_n)^dagger=Co_{P_n}(P_n^dagger). For e<=e_u, lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action gives ||u_{P,n} dot A-A||<=C_u*e||A|| and ||A dot u_{P,n}-A||<=C_u*e||A||. Moreover P_n is a delta-projection and ||P_n||=||P||, so nonvanishing of P passes to every P_n; for e<=e_N, lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm gives abs(||u_{P,n}||-1)<=C_N*e at every level.
